explication: freeCodeCamp is a free, self-paced learning platform whose core journey is to choose curriculum, complete interactive lessons and projects, pass an exam, and claim a certification. The client also supports daily challenges, learner profiles and settings, and donations; the API exposes corresponding platform services. The sampled files show API setup, local code persistence, and Python execution, but not the full client-to-API submission wiring. The README documents the certification journey; other major branches are represented from the repository tree without assuming their internal call paths.
